title: Individual differences in T1w/T2w ratio development during childhood.
authors: Boroshok AL, McDermott CL, Fotiadis P, Park AT, Tooley UA, Gataviņš MM, Tisdall MD, Bassett DS, Mackey AP.
figures: T1w/T2w ratio group averages and age effects.  (A) Group average T1w/T2w ratio maps from the current sample of healthy, neurotypical children ages 4–10 years. Whole-brain, uncorrected T1w/T2w ratio images showing associations between T1w/T2w ratios and variables of interest.  (A-B) Associations between T1w/T2w ratios and socioeconomic status measures. tables: Associations between T1w/T2w ratios (median of intensities within each cortical system) and variables of interest.  Relationships are shown for socioeconomic status, cognitive performance on select subtests of the WPPSI-IV, and eruption of permanent molars. Standardized effect sizes and raw  p -values are reported in the first row. Partial eta-squared effect sizes are reported in the second row.
